scope: All 44 table environments indexed by the VCF-only table inventory for VCFv4.5. The raw TeX file has additional BCF tables outside this VCF-only scope; BCF remains a separate conformance domain.
method: Each indexed VCF table is linked to exact source line ranges and nearest enclosing heading, assigned a review target class for navigation, and left NOT_REVIEWED until its rows are semantically reconciled with surrounding prose, definitions, footnotes, examples and cross-references. Row terminator counts are not treated as semantic row counts.

counts.bcf_tables_excluded_from_vcf_scope: Raw TeX also contains BCF serialization tables; these are excluded from this VCF-only queue.
